trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اِلٰهِیْ غَارَتْ نُجُوْمُ سَمَائِكَ وَنَامَتْ عُیُوْنُ اَنَامِكَ وَهَدَاَتْ اَصْوَاتُ عِبَادِكَ وَاَنْعَامِكَ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْمُلُوْكُ عَاَیْهَا اَبْوَابَهَا وَطَافَ عَلَیْهَا حُرَّاسُهَا وَاحْتَجَبُوْا عَمَّنْ یَّسْئَلُهُمْ حَاجَۃً اَوْیَنْتَجِعُ مِنْهُمْ فَائِدَۃً۔

lines.rarabic: ILAAHEE GHAA-RAT NOJOO-MO SAMAA-E-KA WA NAAMAT O’YOO-NO ANAA-ME-KA WA HADA-AT AS-WAATO E’BAADE-KA WA A’N-AA’MEKA WA GHALLA-QATIL MOLOO-KO A’AIY-HAA AB-WAABA-HAA WA TAAFA A’LAI-HAA HUR-RAASO-HAA WAH-TAJA-BOO A’MMAN YAS-ALO-HUM HAA-JATAN AW-YAN-TAJE-O’ MIN-HUM FAA-E-DATAN.

trans.en: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family. My God, the stars of Your sky have sunk and the eyes of Your people are sleeping and the voices of Your servants and Your animals have become silent and the kings have locked their doors and its guards are moving around it and they are covered from he who wishes to ask them for a need or to get a benefit from them.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: وَاَنْتَ اِلٰهِیْ حَیٌّ قَیٌّوْمٌ لَا تَاخُذُكَ سِنَۃٌ وَّلَا نَوْمٌ وَلَا یَشْغَلُكَ شَیْءٌ عَنْ شَیْءٍ اَبْوَابُ سَمَائِكَ لِمَنْ دَعَاكَ مُفَتَّحَاتٌ وَخَزَائِنُكَ غَیْرُ مُغَلَّقَاتٍ وَاَبْوَابُ رَحْمَتِكَ غَیْرُ مَحْجُوْبَاتٍ وَفَوَائِدُكَ لِمَنْ سَاَلَكَ غَیْرُ مَحْظُوْرَاتٍ بَلْ هِیَ مَبْذُوْلَاتٌ۔

lines.rarabic: WA ANTA ILAA-HEE HAIY-YOON QAIYYOO-MOON LAA TAA KHOZO-KA SENA-TOON WA LAA NAW-MOON WA LAA YASH-GHALO-KA SHAI-OON A’N SHAI-IN AB-WAABO SAMAA-E-KA LEMAN DA-AA’KA MO-FATTA-HAA-TOON WA KHAZAA-E-NOKA GHAIRO MO-GHALLA-QAA-TIN WA AB-WAABO RAHMATE-KA GHAIRO MAHJOO-BAA-TIN WA FAWAA-E-DOKA LEMAN SA-ALAKA GHAIRO MAHZOO-RAA-TIN BAL HEYA MABZOO-LAA-TOON.

trans.en: But You my God, are Ever Living, Subsistent, slumber or sleep does not overtake you and one thing does not occupy You from another; the doors of Your sky are open for he who asks You and Your treasures are never locked and the doors of Your mercy are never covered and Your benefits are never forbidden for he who asks You rather they are given generously.

arabic.text: اَنْتَ اِلٰهِیْ اَلْكَرِیْمُ الَّذِیْ لَا تَرُدُّسَائِلًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ سَاَلَكَ وَلَا تَحْتَجِبُ عَنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ اَرَادَكَ لَا وَعِزَّتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَلَا تُخْتَزَلُ حَوَائِجَهُمْ دُوْنَكَ وَلَا یَقْضِیْهَا اَحَدٌ غَیْرُكَ۔

lines.rarabic: ANTA ILAAHEE AL-KAREE-MUL LAZEE LAA TARUDDO SAA-E-LAN MENAL MO-MENEENA SA-ALAKA WA LAA TAHTE-JEBO A’N AHA-DIN MIN-HUM ARAA-DAKA LAA WA I’ZZATE-KA WA JALAALE-KA WA LAA TUKH-TAZA-LO HAWAA-E-JA-HUM DOO-NAKA WA LAA YAQZEE-HAA AHA-DUN GHAIRO-KA.

trans.en: You are my God, the Generous who does not turn away a beseecher who asks from You and You do not conceal Yourself from anyone of the believers who intends You no, by Your honor and Your Majesty no one removes their needs other than You and no one fulfills their needs apart from You.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَقَدْ تَرَانِیْ وَ وُقُوْفِیْ دَذُلَّ مَقَامِیْ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ وَتَعْلَمُ سَرِیْرَتِیْ وَتَطَّلِعُ عَلٰی مَا فِیْ قَلْبِیْ وَمَا یَصْلِحُ بِهٖ اَمْرُ آخِرَتِیْ وَدُنْیَایَ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ ذِآرَ الْمَوْتِ وَاَهْوَالِ الْمُطَّلِعِ وَالْوُقُوْفَ بَیْنَ یَدَیْكَ نَغَّصَنِیْ مَطْعَمِیْ وَمَشْرَ بِیْ وَاَغَصَّنِیْ بِرِیْقِیْ اَقْلَقَنِیْ عَنْ وِسَادِیْ وَمَنَعَنِیْ رُقَادِیْ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA WA QAD TARAA-NEE WA WO-QOO FEE DA-ZULLA MAQAA-MEE BAIYNA YA-DAIY-KA WA TA’LAMO SA-REERA-TEE WA TAT-TALE-O’ A’LAA MAA FEE QALBEE WA MAA YASLE-HO BEHI AMRO AAKHERA-TEE WA DUNYAA-YA. ALLAAHUMMA INNA ZE-AA-RAL MAWTE WA AHWAA-LIL MUTTA-LE-E’ WAL WOQOO-FA BAIYNA YA-DAIY-KA NAGH-GHASA-NEE MAT-A’MEE WA MASHRA-BEE WA A-GHASSA-NEE BE-REE-QEE AQLA-QANEE A’N WESAA-DEE WA MANA-A’NEE ROKAA-DEE.

trans.en: O Allah You see me, and my standing (before You) and my humble position in front of You and You know my secrets and are aware of what is in my heart and of what will improve my affairs of the Hereafter and the world. O Allah, the remembrance of death and the frightening conditions of the observer and standing before You makes me stay away from my food and drink and makes me choke, keeps me away from my pillow and prevents me from sleeping.

arabic.text: اَیْفَ یَنَامُ مَنْ یَّخَافُ مَلَكَ الْمَوْتِ فِیْ طَوَارِقِ اللَّیْلِ وَطَوَارِقِ النَّهَارِ بَلْ اَیْفَ یَنَامُ الْعَاقِلُ وَمَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ لَا یَنَامُ لَا بِاللَّیْلِ وَلَا بِالنَّهَارِ وَیَطْلُبُ رُوْحَهُ بِالْبَیَاتِ وَفِیْ اَنَاءِالسَّاعَاتِ اَسْئَلُكَ الرَّوْحَ وَالرَّاحَۃَ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَالْعَفْوَ عَنِّیْ حِیْنَ اَلْقَاكَ۔

lines.rarabic: AIY-FA YANAA-MO MAN YA-KHAAFO MALAKAL MAWTE FEE TAWAARE-QIL LAIY-LE WA TAWAARE-KIN NAHAA-RE BAL AIY-FA YONAA-MUL AA’QELO WA MALAKUL MAWTE LAA YANAA-MO LAA BIL LAIY-LE WA LAA BIN NEHAA-RE WA YAT-LOBO ROOHA-HO BIL BAYAA-TE WA FEE ANAA-IS SAA-AA’TE AS-ALO-KAR TAWHA WAR RAA-HATA I’NDAL MAWTE WAL A’F-WA A’NNEE HEENA AL-QAAKA.

trans.en: How can one sleep who fears the angel of death? in the calamities of the night and the calamities of the day rather how can an intelligent person sleep while the angel of death does not sleep neither at night nor in the day and seeks his soul in the state of sleep and in the middle of the hours. I beseech You to give me ease and comfort at the time of death and forgiveness when I meet You.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
